# mobile-starter

> A React Native starter kit on Expo SDK 57 (RN 0.86, React 19), verified green on a
> real iOS simulator and a real Android emulator. Written to be adopted by coding
> agents as much as by people: the conventions and the traps are written down.

Repository: https://github.com/mutaaf/mobile-starter
Licence: MIT

## Start here

The binding contract is AGENTS.md. It is self-contained — an agent working in a
different repository can read that one file and apply the same conventions.

- AGENTS.md (contract, 16 invariants): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mutaaf/mobile-starter/main/AGENTS.md
- Adoption guide (incl. web-to-mobile mapping): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mutaaf/mobile-starter/main/docs/ADOPTING.md
- Distribution (APK / IPA / EAS): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mutaaf/mobile-starter/main/docs/DISTRIBUTION.md
- README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mutaaf/mobile-starter/main/README.md

## Commands

npm run verify        # typecheck + lint + unit tests — the gate
npm test              # unit tests (51)
npm run ios           # build, install and launch on an iOS simulator
npm run android       # build, install and launch on an Android emulator
npm run e2e:ios       # Maestro, against a running simulator
npm run e2e:android   # Maestro, against a running emulator

E2E needs a booted device with the app already installed, so it is deliberately
not part of `verify`.

## Architecture

Screens never fetch. They call useResource(key, fetcher) and render the result.
Every request goes through one ResourceCache that owns stale-while-revalidate,
single-flight dedup, persistence and instrumentation.

  screen -> useResource -> ResourceCache -> CacheStore (interface)
                                         -> TieredStore = MemoryStore + AsyncStorageStore

The cache is injected via <CacheProvider>, not imported as a singleton, so tests
mount a memory-only instance. Adding a data source is three steps: a fetcher in
src/lib/api.ts, a key in CacheKeys, a useResource call.

## Demo app

Six screens against five sources. All the public APIs are keyless and HTTPS.

- Orbit   — ISS position (wheretheiss.at); 4s polling, interpolated ground track
- Seismic — USGS earthquakes M2.5+/24h; long list, magnitude bars
- Aurora  — NOAA SWPC planetary Kp; animated SVG gauge, scrubbable sparkline
- Launch  — Launch Library 2 manifest; 20 live countdowns on one shared clock
- Motion  — on-device accelerometer/gyroscope; bubble level, haptics, gestures
- Brief   — bring-your-own LLM key (Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini); fuses all four
            feeds plus the handset's tilt and clock into one situation report

## Invariants an agent must not break

1.  `render` from React Native Testing Library v14 is async — always await it.
2.  Jest needs resolver "react-native-worklets/jest/resolver.js" (Reanimated 4).
3.  moduleNameMapper must mirror the tsconfig path aliases; Jest ignores tsconfig.
4.  .css imports need a Jest stub and an ambient declaration.
5.  Unit tests live in __tests__/, never under src/app/ (expo-router routes).
6.  Assert on testID in Maestro wherever an element contains an icon — iOS folds
    the SF Symbol name into the parent accessibility label.
7.  Never call setState synchronously inside an effect.
8.  cache.getState() must return a referentially stable object.
9.  AsyncStorage needs its Jest mock, registered in jest-setup.ts.
10. Mutate cache policy through setPolicy(), never the object.
11. Animate on the UI thread; high-frequency sources must not round-trip React.
12. A helper called from a worklet must itself be a worklet (module scope +
    'worklet'), or the UI runtime throws "Tried to synchronously call a Remote
    Function".
13. Start animations in effects, never in useMemo — React may skip a memo body.
14. useFrameCallback is NOT a vsync frame counter (measured ~8/sec against a
    28ms median frame). Use `adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo <package>` for real data.
15. API keys go in expo-secure-store, never the cache — that tier is plain text
    on disk and the devtools panel dumps it.
16. Bind pull-to-refresh to user intent, not to `status`.

Full text, each with the symptom it produces when broken, is in AGENTS.md.

## Native projects

ios/ and android/ are generated by `expo prebuild` and are gitignored. Never
hand-edit them. Express native config through app.json plugins. Add native
dependencies with `npx expo install`, then `npx expo prebuild --clean`.

## Scope

Not included: auth, a data layer beyond the demo feeds, store submission. The E2E
suite is two flows proving the harness works, not coverage. CI runs on emulators
and simulators only. A device-installable IPA requires a paid Apple Developer
account; a sideloadable APK builds locally with none.
